correctness.how: Four code-based task contracts assert the manifest, brief, ranked evidence, access gaps and cache decision. No golden reference document exists for this deliverable, so there is no golden comparison.

cost.note: No tokens, dollars or spread have been recorded. The suite runs local Python scripts rather than a model, so there is no session log to parse until an agentic arm exists.

time.note: duration_ms is harness runtime, not a saving. No human baseline has been recorded, so time saved is unknown and is not reported.

with-skills.note: The deterministic harness exercises the shipped context scripts in a fresh temporary workspace.

baseline-no-skills.note: No comparison arm exists. There is no meaningful no-skills version of a script-driven run: the baseline arm becomes constructible once a model, rather than the harness, drives the workflow.
baseline-no-skills.unblocked_by: An agentic arm where a model is asked for the same evidence pack with the Ascent skills unavailable.

consistency.note: Unknown, not predictable. One run of a deterministic script says nothing about the cost spread of the agentic workflow this suite stands in for. Fewer than three runs per arm cannot support a verdict.

coverage.rationale: The implemented contract and scripts should pass reliably; new agent-driven source adapters would be added as capability coverage.

trials.rationale: This package exercises deterministic local scripts in an isolated workspace. Per-task trials are distinct from runs_per_arm, which measures cost and time reproducibility.

graders.rationale: Source records, ranked output, gaps, persisted files, and cache decisions are objectively inspectable.
Avoiding unavailable source-body leakage and broadening is an explicit behavior requirement.

skills_invoked.note: The harness calls the scripts directly, so this suite cannot show that a model would invoke the right skills.

required: Confirm the opportunity root before writing a local projection
Confirm the concrete task before retrieving source content
clarifying_questions.note: There is no user turn in a script-driven run.

gaps.question: cost
gaps.statement: No tokens or dollars have been recorded for this suite.
gaps.unblocked_by: An agentic arm producing a session log, parsed by the deterministic telemetry harness into ascent.eval-run-record.v1 files.

gaps.question: cost
gaps.statement: The same job has never been run without the Ascent skills, so nothing here is a saving.
gaps.unblocked_by: A baseline-no-skills arm on the same host, model, prompt and fixture.

gaps.question: cost
gaps.statement: How much the cost jumps around is unknown; the suite runs once and measures no tokens.
gaps.unblocked_by: At least three runs per arm with recorded token totals.

gaps.question: time
gaps.statement: No one has timed a human assembling this evidence pack, so no hours-saved figure can be quoted.
gaps.unblocked_by: One timed manual run, or a dated delivery-lead estimate with a named source.

gaps.question: correctness
gaps.statement: There is no known-good human document to compare against; the deliverable is machine-local state, not a client document.
gaps.unblocked_by: Moving the reference-based comparison to the downstream document-producing skills, where a real approved deliverable exists.

gaps.question: correctness
gaps.statement: We guessed these failures from the design; we have not yet watched it fail for real.
gaps.unblocked_by: Error analysis on real skill traces: open coding, axial coding, frequency counts.

gaps.question: correctness
gaps.statement: This suite cannot show that a model would invoke the right skills or ask the right questions, because the harness calls the scripts itself.
gaps.unblocked_by: An agentic arm whose session log records skill invocations and user turns.

aggregation.note: The aggregator reads ascent.eval-run-record.v1 files from results/runs/. This suite does not emit them yet; its runner writes a single legacy result to results/latest.json.

transcript_review.sample: all failures; inspect generated artifacts when a target script changes
transcript_review.rationale: The deterministic runner has no agent transcript, so the artifacts are the diagnosis record.

taxonomy.notes: Reference classification, not the headline. Deterministic scripts under a code-based harness, so no model or human grader is in the loop and no pass@k/pass^k estimator applies. Interaction scope is single-turn because the harness invokes the skill scripts directly; it is not yet an agentic eval. reference-based here means each task has a reference solution, not that a golden human document exists.
